instruction: Implement the JSONL usage report in app/events.py, app/report.py, and app/cli.py. Parse nonblank JSON objects whose kind is request, whose id and model are nonempty strings, and whose input_tokens and output_tokens are nonnegative integers (booleans are invalid). Count malformed or invalid nonblank lines in invalidLines; blank lines do not count. Deduplicate valid records by id with the last valid record winning while preserving first-seen id order. Aggregate requests by model with numeric inputTokens and outputTokens totals, sorted lexicographically. The JSON report is exactly {"invalidLines": integer, "models": [{"model": string, "requests": integer, "inputTokens": integer, "outputTokens": integer}, ...]}. The CSV report has exactly the header model,requests,input_tokens,output_tokens followed by one LF-terminated row per sorted model; use standard CSV quoting for commas, quotes, and embedded newlines. The CLI invocation is app/cli.py INPUT|- [--format json|csv]; it writes only the selected report to stdout and returns a nonzero status with no traceback for argument or file errors. Use Python standard library only and change only the declared app files.

args: import sys; sys.path.insert(0, 'app'); import events, report, cli
